Do I Need a New Air Conditioner?

Our team is here to help you determine whether repairing your AC system or replacing it with a new unit makes the most sense. If your HVAC system is at least ten to 15 years old, we recommend scheduling an inspection. Older air conditioners are not as energy efficient as newer models, and replacing your existing unit will likely save you money on monthly energy bills. The following are some reasons you should replace your air conditioning system rather than have it repaired:

Frequent Repairs – If you’ve had repairs more than twice in any particular season, you likely need a residential air conditioning installation.
Rising Energy Bills – Cooling bills should not go up very much over time. Significant increases likely mean you need a new HVAC system.
Uncomfortable Home – If it seems impossible to get your home to stay cool without running the air too much, you likely need a new AC system. Try changing your filters first.
Poor Air Quality – A failing AC system could lead to poor indoor air quality. If you have an allergy or asthma symptoms inside your home, it’s time for an inspection.

Before having a new air conditioner installed in your home, you need to know what to consider. We can help you choose the perfect AC system for your home, considering the size of your home, your budget, and more. Adding an air conditioning system to your home will reduce humidity levels, but it’s critical to choose the correct sized system.
